content.title: What Is Darwinism? (1874)
content.author: Charles Hodge
content.note: The Princeton theologian's answer to Darwin: that Darwin's theory, by excluding design, is atheistic, while Darwin himself and many who accept evolution are not atheists. Cited as a nineteenth-century Christian response, not as the site's view. Public domain: may be quoted.
